text:
Theo (Design): Quick question on the drilldown header: should the Copy correlation ID live as an inline icon or inside the kebab? Keyboard + SR flow feels awkward today. Lina (Product): We added the icon because customers wanted one-click copying. But if it breaks keyboard order that's bad. What's the exact issue? Kai (Eng-Frontend): Current DOM order: [Export][Close][CopyID]. So tab goes Export -> Close -> Copy. Users expect Copy right after Close or before Export. Also the Copy icon is icon-only w/o `aria-label`. Nadia (Accessibility): Important points: 1) icon buttons need `aria-label` (no tooltips for SR) 2) copying should trigger an `aria-live` announcement, but keep message short: "Correlation ID copied." 3) avoid reading the full 32-char ID aloud. Maya (Eng-UX): Proposal: make Export the left-most primary action, then kebab for secondary actions which includes Copy ID, Copy link, and "Open session". On wide screens keep Copy visible but move it to be adjacent to Close so order is Export -> Close -> Copy. On narrow screens put it in kebab. Theo (Design): Copy wording: "Copy correlation ID" vs "Copy ID"? I prefer specificity even if slightly longer. Also microcopy under export: "Bundle = spans + logs + attachments" — should we show that? Lina (Product): Yes show short helper text under Export: "Bundle includes spans, logs, and attachments." And prefer "Copy correlation ID" for clarity. Kai (Eng-Frontend): Implementation notes: will fix `tabindex` (we had some `tabindex="-1"` left over), add `aria-labels`, and implement a small `role="status"` region for announcements. Quick CSS tweak to make export color pass contrast: `background: #c4433a; color: #fff;`. Nadia (Accessibility): Contrast target 4.5:1 normal text. Please attach color contrast screenshots to PR. For the `role=status` use `aria-atomic="true"` and send generic text. Eg: `
Correlation ID copied.
`. Maya (Eng-UX): Analytics: keep the `event_name` stable (`trace_export.click`), add a property `export_type: bundle|json`. For copy action use `trace_copy.clicked` with `copy_target: correlation_id|url`. Don't rename existing events. Theo (Design): Accessibility + UX question: when Copy is in kebab, how should keyboard focus behave? Users should be able to tab to kebab then arrow into menu items. No trap loops. Kai (Eng-Frontend): We'll make menu `aria-haspopup="menu"` and use roving tabindex inside. Tab opens menu focus to first item; arrow keys navigate; Escape closes and returns focus to kebab. That matches ARIA best practices. Lina (Product): Plan: 1) Move rarely used actions into kebab on mobile 2) Keep Copy visible on desktop but next to Close 3) Update copy to "Copy correlation ID" and Export to "Download bundle" (menu offers "Export JSON") 4) Add SR announcements + contrast fixes 5) Analytics properties as above. Who will take the PR? Kai (Eng-Frontend): I'll pick it up. Will: update DOM order, add `aria-label`s, implement `role=status` live region, and adjust CSS. Will include screenshots and a 10s keyboard-only recording in PR. Nadia (Accessibility): PR checklist for me to review: 1) `aria-label` on icon buttons 2) `role=status` + `aria-atomic` for announcements 3) menu uses `role=menu` and proper keyboard handling 4) contrast screenshots 5) short keyboard-only video. Maya (Eng-UX): I'll update the design spec and add a short note in the console docs about the export variants and analytics fields. ops-bot: Note: small UI deploy window tomorrow 01:00-02:00 UTC. Low risk. Lina (Product): Great — let's try to get the PR in today. After deploy we'll run a quick internal a11y pass and a 2-person hallway test. Thanks all. Theo (Design): Thanks — I'll push the copy file updates to the PR too.
